name: turn_selected_object_toward_position

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_TurnSelectedObjectTowardPosition consumes three target coordinates and one duration, queues a ROT operation for the selected object, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: ScriptCommand_TurnSelectedObjectTowardPosition subtracts the selected object's current position from the requested coordinates, queues the resulting direction vector and encoded duration through the object-operation dispatcher, and sets Script flag bit 1 until the turn completes. Command 98 wait_for_selected_object_turn polls that flag. The JP corpus contains 156 calls, and command 98 is the next command call for 90 of them.
